name: Apex Maverick Men's Suede Loafers
description: Lightweight dark navy men's slip-on loafers crafted with a soft suede upper and an unlined minimalist interior for a breathable, barefoot sensation in summer heat. Features a supportive contoured cushion footbed that relieves foot fatigue during all-day walking. Easily styled with chinos, formal trousers, or festive Panjabi.
